title: Bio-mimetic Structures
description: An exploration into load-bearing structures inspired by biological systems, grown through computational processes.

title: Generative Material Systems
description: Research on materials that can adapt and respond to environmental stimuli, creating self-regulating systems.

title: Data-driven Ecologies
description: A series of installations that visualize and respond to real-time ecological data, fostering a connection with nature.

title: Interactive Pavilion
description: A public installation that responds to human movement and environmental conditions.

title: 3D Printed Coral Reefs
description: A project to restore marine ecosystems using 3D printed structures that encourage coral growth.

title: Living Facade
description: A building facade integrated with a bioreactor to grow algae for biofuel and air purification.
